evidence.description: The non-credit-card default block expects monthly loss and deal-balance fields and constructs cumulative loss percentage.
evidence.quote:
*calculate deal-level default rate
*net_loss: net loss in each month
*cum_loss: cumumlative losses over time
*deal_balance: the deal balance in each month
*orig_deal_balance: the deal balance at issuance
*t: each year-month minus origination year-month

*all ABS except for credit card ABS 
egen group=group(mtg_deal_name)
tsset group t
bys group: gen cum_loss2=sum(net_loss)
replace cum_loss=cum_loss2 if cum_loss==.
bys group: gen sum=sum(deal_balance)
bys group: gen no=_n
gen deal_balance_avg=sum/no
replace orig_deal_balance=deal_balance_avg if orig_deal_balance==.
drop cum_loss2 sum no deal_balance_avg
gen cum_loss_pct=cum_loss/orig_deal_balance*100

evidence.description: The default block selects the observation nearest issue_date plus 183 days and saves the intermediate temp_1.
evidence.quote:
gen s1=issue_date+183
*gen s1=issue_date+121
*gen s1=issue_date+244
gen dif=abs(date-s1)
bys mtg: egen min=min(dif)
keep if min==dif
bys mtg: egen max=max(t)
keep if max==t
tsset group
*gen delq_60plus_pct=delq60plus/orig_deal_balance*100
*gen delq_90plus_pct=delq90plus/orig_deal_balance*100
keep mtg_deal_name cum_loss_pct
save temp_1,replace

evidence.description: The credit-card block constructs cumulative losses from charge-offs and pool balances, then appends temp_1.
evidence.quote:
*credit card ABS
egen group=group(mtg_deal_name)
tsset group t
gen net_loss=charge_off_dollar
bys group: gen cum_loss   =sum(net_loss)
bys group: gen cum_balance=sum(pool_balance_dollar)
gen cum_loss_pct=cum_loss/cum_balance*100
gen s1=issue_date+183
*gen s1=issue_date+121
*gen s1=issue_date+244
gen dif=abs(date-s1)
bys mtg: egen min=min(dif)
keep if min==dif
bys mtg: egen max=max(t)
keep if max==t
tsset group
keep mtg_deal_name cum_loss_pct delq_60plus_pct delq_90plus_pct
append using temp_1
save default,replace

evidence.description: The risk-layering block identifies ABS-EE loan fields and weighted FICO/LTV construction.
evidence.quote:
*calculate risk layering at the loan level
*based on abs-ee data of 108 auto deals
gen size=reportingperiodactualendbalancea
replace size=reportingperiodendingactualbalan if size==.
gen     fico=obligorcreditscore
replace fico=lesseecreditscore if fico==.
replace fico=900 if fico>900 & fico!=.
replace fico=. if fico==0
gen fico_miss=1 if fico==.
replace fico=. if fico<300
gen s1=fico*size
gen s2=size if s1!=.
bys mtg_deal_name: egen sum1=sum(s1)
bys mtg_deal_name: egen sum2=sum(s2)
gen fico_vw=sum1/sum2
drop s1 s2 sum1 sum2
gen     ltv= originalloanamount/vehiclevalueamount

evidence.description: The loan-level block defines actpay_miss for three deals and documents zero actual payments.
evidence.quote:
gen ats=totalactualamountpaid/reportingperiodscheduledpaymenta if totalactualamountpaid>=0
replace ats=10 if ats>10 & ats!=.
*set a cap for outliers obs: there are 16,430 loans with ats>10, accounting for 0.3% of loans with ats
gen actpay_miss=1 if mtg_deal_name=="drive 2018-4" | mtg_deal_name=="drive 2018-5" | mtg_deal_name=="sdart 2018-5"
*ats is 0 for all loans in three deals because actualamountpaid is 0.

evidence.description: The control-table keep omits actpay_miss, which is referenced by the next replace statement.
evidence.quote:
save abs_ee,replace
keep mtg_deal_name fico_vw ltv_vw ats_vw p2i_vw low_doc_vw 
duplicates drop
replace ats_vw=0.829676 if actpay_miss==1
*for the three deals with ats value of 0 for all loans, we replace their average with the average ats_vw of other deals issued by the same issuer in the same year before these deals.
save control,replace

evidence.description: The code retains the authored FICO/LTV/P2I thresholds, missing-payment adjustment, and 0.48 factor.
evidence.quote:
gen     r1=1 if fico<=642 & fico!=.
replace r1=0 if fico!=. & r1==.
*642 is the 25th percentile
gen     r2=1 if ltv>=1.128116 & ltv!=.
replace r2=0 if ltv!=. & r2==.
*1.128116 is the 25th percentile
gen     r3=1 if ats<1 
replace r3=0 if ats!=. & r3==.
gen     r4=1 if p2i>=.1286 & p2i!=.
replace r4=0 if p2i!=. & r4==.
*.1286 is the 25th percentile
gen     sum=r1+r2+r3+r4+low_doc
replace sum=r1+r2+r4+low_doc if actpay_miss==1 
gen     s1=size      if sum>=3 & sum!=.
replace s1=size*0.48 if sum==2 & actpay_miss==1 
*the likelihood of r3=1 is 48% for other deals by the the same issuer of the three deals with actpay_miss=1.

evidence.description: The risk-layering code uses series and the authored .0276001 and .67 thresholds.
evidence.quote:
gen     rl_high=1 if layer_vw>=.0276001 & layer_vw!=.
replace rl_high=0 if layer_vw<=.0276001
*.0276001 is the median of layer_vw
bys series: egen high_avg=mean(rl_high)
replace rl_high=1 if high_avg>=0.67 & high_avg!=. & rl_high==. & treat==1 & post==0
replace rl_high=0 if high_avg< 0.67               & rl_high==. & treat==1 & post==0
*0.67 is the median of high_avg

actions.description: Confirm the June 2019 Bloomberg ABS sample export or a compatible author-prepared tranche/deal table. Identify exact licensed content and deliverable for the Stata input fields; current general Data License information does not establish that specific product, field coverage, or entitlement.
steps: Obtain the author-prepared table or confirm Bloomberg ABS product, release/vintage, sample population, field names, units, and permitted access for the required tranche/deal variables.

Keep the source fields for deal/tranche names, ratings, coupon type/rate, principal amount, weighted-average life, security type, issue date, issuer, and rf/flt_spread inputs aligned with the do-file.
validation: Before author-code execution, confirm field mapping, sample-period coverage, unique deal/tranche keys, and source entitlement without changing the paper sample or formulas.

actions.description: Identify the exact Moody's ABS database vintage and monthly author input used for principal balances and cumulative write-offs; confirm the native-to-Stata field mapping and history needed by the +183-day measure.
steps: Provide the monthly source table or document the Moody's product/release, sample deal universe, date units, and source columns mapped to mtg_deal_name, date/t, losses, balances, and credit-card charge-off/pool-balance fields.
Specify the available history for each deal from origination through the monthly observation nearest issue_date + 183 days; preserve the code's cumulative construction and nearest-date rule.
validation: Check the source periods, deal identifiers, units, non-credit-card and credit-card branches, and the constructed nearest-date observation against the supplied specification before running Stata.

actions.description: For observations missing from the Moody's source, provide the author-used Form 10-D filings or extracted values with a mapping from issuer filing/accession to the affected deal, month, and missing variable.
steps: Obtain the author missingness list and exact 10-D filing/accession references for the values filled from EDGAR.
Retain the source filing and documented extraction fields for each missing principal-balance or cumulative-write-off observation; do not assume Form 10-D prose alone reproduces the monthly panel.
validation: Reconcile only the reported missing observations and confirm the extracted values, dates, identifiers, and units against the author-provided monthly input.

steps: Identify the 108 deals and their ABS-EE filing/accession documents, date/vintage coverage, loan-row unit, and any author extraction program or manual steps.

Map source filing fields to the Stata columns for balances, FICO, loan amount/vehicle value/acquisition cost, actual/scheduled payments, payment-to-income, and income/employment verification; preserve the authored caps, constants, and thresholds.
validation: Confirm all required source fields and deal identifiers against the author table before the risk-layer block; do not infer mappings from filing document titles or the SEC access logs.
